Preserve inherited lint warnings by exact baseline source context while rejecting every current error or new warning; existing zero-warning CI remains unchanged.

patches.purpose: For persistent local folders, compare original disk bytes immediately before and during an exclusive per-file write. Keep an externally changed disk file and the browser draft, report a distinct conflict, and carry the known previous version through FileStore, directory imports, Git worktree operations and an in-page folder-permission interruption. Each browser tab records the content it actually opened instead of substituting a newer shared IndexedDB value as its disk-write baseline. Preserve the inherited account-mode write behavior and the existing browser compiler scheduler.
tests: real Chromium two-tab and process-restart folder saves
patches.removalCondition: Upstream supplies equivalent conditional local-folder writes, external edit conflict reporting and browser draft retention across the same callers.
patches.integrationStatus: Source 8fcf31d passed public PR CI 38226520690: 49 foundation, 179 focused and 1126 full cases, types, lint, package assets and external archive review; 16 inherited skips remain. Actual Chromium process restart and browser-owned reauthorization wrote the retained draft when disk was unchanged, but rejected it and retained both versions after a synthetic external disk edit. Actual two-tab Chromium first reproduced a stale-tab overwrite, then retained the newer tab's disk version, the stale tab's browser draft and a visible failure after using the existing per-tab content cache as the conditional-write baseline. The permission-interruption baseline is currently in-memory for the open page; durable recovery after another close remains pending. Other N02 acceptance remains pending. Browser File System Access does not provide an atomic directory transaction or lock against every other program.
